# ZynqToon

> ZynqToon is a modern, fast, editorial web platform for reading Manga, Manhwa, and Manhua in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) and English. Designed with an ultra-dark sleek aesthetic, high-speed image loading, zero AI-slop layout, and instant search.

## Core Features
- **Multi-Source Catalog**: Aggregates verified scanlations and chapters from MangaDex, Sansekai, and Bacakomik with real-time updates.
- **Bilingual Reading**: Full support for Bahasa Indonesia (ID) and English (EN) translations.
- **Ultra-Fast Reader**: Fluid vertical continuous webtoon scroll mode and single-page flip mode with keyboard navigation.
- **Zero Ads & Zero Popups**: Clean, distraction-free editorial layout.
- **Cloud Sync & Local Bookmarks**: Seamless guest reading history and Supabase cloud bookmark sync.

## Main Navigation Links
- [Homepage](https://zynqtoon.vercel.app/): Featured hero releases, trending manga, latest chapter updates, and Indonesian recommendations.
- [Trending](https://zynqtoon.vercel.app/trending): Top ranked manga, manhwa, and manhua of the week.
- [Genres](https://zynqtoon.vercel.app/genre): Filter comics by Action, Romance, Fantasy, Isekai, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Shounen, Seinen, and Supernatural.
- [Bookmarks](https://zynqtoon.vercel.app/bookmarks): User reading lists, saved series, and reading history tracker.

## Popular Categories
- **Manhwa (Korean Webtoons)**: Full-color vertical scroll action, fantasy, leveling, and reincarnation stories.
- **Manga (Japanese Comics)**: Classic and modern black-and-white serialization.
- **Manhua (Chinese Comics)**: Martial arts, cultivation, and fantasy epic series.

## Technical Specifications & API
- Next.js 16 App Router on Turbopack with React 19.
- Cloudflare CDN edge acceleration for images and zero-CLS image loading.
- High-contrast editorial color system: `#070709` (Canvas), `#111115` (Surface), `#F27D26` (Flame Accent).
